main.description: Searches organizations by associated profile text and optional filters. Filters combine with AND, and values within each array filter are ORed. Authentication is not required.

search.description: Trimmed text is matched literally and case-insensitively as a substring in either displayName or description. Blank text is unrestricted; nonblank text requires an associated profile.

actors.description: Actor DIDs to include; values are ORed and handles are not resolved.

organizationTypes.description: Exact organizationType values; OR within this filter.

visibility.description: Exact visibility match; omission is unrestricted, but records with no visibility value do not match.

sortDirection.description: Sort by a valid zoned createdAt, otherwise indexedAt, falling back to row creation time; URI breaks ties. Default desc.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep other parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter or scalar parameter is invalid or repeated, or an unsupported parameter was supplied.

errors.name: OrganizationQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed organization sidecar or associated profile could not be queried.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
